expansion_name: Architects of the West Kingdom: Age of Artisans
prerequisite_rule: Needs Architects of the West Kingdom; plays on its own with the base game.
what_it_adds: Components for a 6th player (orange), a personal Artisan meeple that counts as two workers, 24 Craft Cards usable as Adornments or Tools, 12 new Apprentices, 12 new Buildings, a dual-layer Guildhall overlay, two new player boards and a score pad.
what_it_fixes: Gives a score pad the base game lacks, adds a free starting Apprentice and doubles the Apprentice and Building decks so repeat plays vary more.
verdict_reason: Board Game Quest says to pick this first if you buy only one Architects expansion because it adds strong choices while being very easy to integrate, and a designer says on BGG they would not play without its Buildings and Apprentices.
notes: Zatu notes the orange player colour is easy to confuse with gold pieces and the box has a lot of air. Cards from this box can be shuffled straight into the base decks.

expansion_name: Architects of the West Kingdom: Works of Wonder
prerequisite_rule: Needs Architects of the West Kingdom; can be combined with Age of Artisans but does not require it.
what_it_adds: An Influence board and track, a Princess and a Profiteer meeple that move around the board, five buildable Wonders, 24 Apprentices, 24 Buildings, 12 Reward cards, six new player boards and a new solo system with 3 AI boards and 24 scheme cards.
what_it_fixes: Adds a way to trigger Black Market resets and a spendable Influence resource, and replaces the base game's solo opponent with a richer one.
verdict_reason: Board Game Quest and Dude Take Your Turn both like it but call it less elegant and more complex than Age of Artisans, and BGG owners split on whether it is essential outside solo play.
notes: The Black Market reset steps get longer; one BGG poster suggests the rules-keen player runs the reset for the table. Several BGG posters call it a must-have for solo play.

requires_also: Paladins of the West Kingdom; Viscounts of the West Kingdom
prerequisite_rule: Requires Architects of the West Kingdom plus Paladins of the West Kingdom and Viscounts of the West Kingdom to play.
what_it_adds: Campaign mode that links all three West Kingdom games with tome scoring, plus a separate cooperative Overlord mode for each game and 4 bonus Architects player boards.
what_it_fixes: Gives owners of all three West Kingdom games a way to play them as one linked campaign or co-operatively.
verdict_reason: The publisher states it needs all three West Kingdom games, so it only makes sense for owners of Architects, Paladins and Viscounts who want campaign or co-op play.
notes: Cross-game product for the whole West Kingdom trilogy, not an Architects-only box. Verdict rests on the publisher's requirement text; no independent full review was read.
